mathematical_apparatus_manifest.batch_representation: Counts, total, ratio, outcome and pair_bank are pure properties of the compact emitted BatchRecord. decoder.exact_json serializes stored fields; those derived properties have the explicit formulas in apparatus.py and are not additional sampled outcomes.
mathematical_apparatus_manifest.helper_output_scope: Support and Controller are internal transition objects; passive PairRecord, UnitRecord, FiberRange and PairBank are views of the existing relation. Every stored field is inventoried with AUXILIARY D_clock ownership and does not emit an additional interaction.

interface.prefix_convention: prefix(L) returns exactly L frames, cuts 0..L-1; L=0 yields an empty frame tuple with retained header. For 0<=M<=L the first M frames equal prefix(M).
interface.finite_resource_boundary: Each finite requested prefix uses exact finite work and finite support mathematically; no claim of uniform runtime, bounded memory or materialization of infinite history.
interface.stage_domain_boundary: D_geom and D_clock are total on the named compatible graphs, not on arbitrary products of source and mismatched records.
interface.reading_assignment_boundary: D_linear geometry assignment means candidate maps linear in initial v over the declared integer/rational carriers; it is not factorization through the F5 CODEC trace. D_quadratic batch assignment includes its signed preparation data and asserts no QDD-Q factorization.
interface.physical_boundary: New geometry source injections have defined mathematical maps but unresolved public layer gates. The existing selected photon transfer gate does not certify those injections or any physical realization.
interface.record_field_surface: All stored fields of the 18 inventoried schemas, including the complete recursive primary History/Frame wire surface, QDD tagged payloads, passive Pair/Fiber views and internal Support/Controller objects; plus the named pure BatchRecord properties. Every row has one owner. Passive/internal rows use AUXILIARY with explicit basis.
interface.no_lookahead_selection: The next checkpoint is calculated by deterministic U on the current checkpoint before its consistency check; the emitted frame still records the current cut. No future observed output is an input.
